title: Signed revoked signing keys list v1
description: v1 (M1-4; shape agreed with services/registry PR #56, lead decision 2026-11-05; design/09-cloud-services.md §8.4, design/03-engine.md §3.1-1). /registry/revoked_keys.json. Signatures from a listed keyId (any role, including root and timestamp keys) are not counted anywhere (packages, hotfixes, policies, status) and journal registry.key_revoked. SIGNATURES (SIGNING.md §3): `signatures` are 2-of-3 distinct pinned offline ROOT keys over the CONTENT = JCS(list without `signatures`, `issuedAt`, `expiresAt`, `timestamp`); root signatures are counted after filtering with the PREVIOUSLY accepted list (a root key can be revoked), the timestamp signature with the new list. keyId must be unique within `revoked` (engine check, registry.schema_invalid). FRESHNESS: `timestamp` (online timestamp key) re-signed every 24 h without content change. Engine-only checks: expiresAt - issuedAt <= 24 h (registry.revoked_validity_too_long); issuedAt > now + 5 min => reject; same keyEpoch, monotonic +1..+1000, equal monotonic only with equal content; the new list must be a superset of the current one (registry.revoked_shrunk, revocation is irreversible). Losing 24 h freshness holds new package/policy/hotfix loads (installed package kept); strictly conservative policy/status still apply.

timestamp.description: Freshness signature by the online timestamp key over JCS({contentDigest, monotonic, issuedAt, expiresAt}) (SIGNING.md §4).
